annotations.title: Get venues a user has checked in at

description: Get the venues a user has checked in at, most recent first, with per-venue first/recent visit and check-in counts. Pages fully for any public/friend account (unlike user check-ins, which stop at ~50 for other users). Untappd returns at most 25 venues per page whatever limit you ask for — advance by the returned pagination offset. Omit username for your own account. Read-only.

limit.description: Max venues (1–50; Untappd caps a page at 25)

sort.description: Sort order (default most recent). Untappd keys: date, recent, date_asc, venue_name_asc, venue_name_desc, highest_checkin, lowest_checkin. Aliases: name = venue_name_asc, checkin = highest_checkin. highest_rated is deprecated (Untappd has no venue rating sort) and is sent as highest_checkin.

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).

name: untappd_user_venues
title: Get venues a user has checked in at
